c: This article primarily features content only available in DLC, which may not be available in all copies of the game.
Myo Lift is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors

rows.label: Rarity
rows.hint: Weapon's weight in the pool of available weapons.

rows.label: Damage
rows.hint: Damage number randomization in ±5 range is only a visual effect. Actual damage dealt is always the same.

rows.label: Amount
rows.hint: Amount of projectiles/areas fired per use.

rows.label: Pierce
rows.hint: Maximum amount of enemies that a projectile can hit.

rows.label: Hitbox Delay
rows.hint: Time before the same enemy can be hit again.

c: Myo Lift summons pale blue lifts on the both sides of the screen that repeatedly traveling up and down and damaging enemies they contact, with its damage being increased by
Orologion. Being a Clockwork weapon, Myo Lift also triggers other Clockwork weapons.
Myo Lift gains a +(1/3)x damage multiplier per +1 Amount, up to a max of x3.333... at +10 Amount
Myo Lift gains a damage bonus in accordance to log(OrologionsFound), meaning they gain +1 Damage for every 10x in Orologions found, starting with +1 Base Damage at 10 Orologions.

Myo Lift has a 2.5 seconds Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every two and a half seconds by the same lift. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
- Increases the likelihood of finding Orologions, which increase Myo Lift's damage.
- Occasionally spawns Orologions whenever the character levels up, indirectly increasing Myo Lift's damage.
Myo Lift has 9 levels. At max level, Myo Lift has +40 Base damage and +200%
Also triggers other clockwork weapons. Damage increased by Amount and currently found Orologions.
With Limit Break, Myo Lift can be further leveled up.
See Combos for a list of all item interactions.
